content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Beats online

This is a complete digital commerce stack built for creators who cannot use Stripe, PayPal, or other restricted platforms. It’s not a plugin or a third-party service. It’s infrastructure you own. The core components are free to deploy: GitHub Pages hosts your store, Cloudflare Workers handle backend logic, and NOWPayments processes crypto payments with a 0.5% fee. The system automates everything—from payment verification to file delivery. When a buyer pays in crypto, the system confirms the transaction on-chain, delivers the beat instantly, and stores the order in a database you control. No buyer accounts are required. No KYC. Just a seamless exchange of value. This architecture is pressure-tested in regions like Zimbabwe, where currency collapse and payment rejection are realities. It’s not built for convenience—it’s built for sovereignty.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

Here’s how it works: Your store lives on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages—both free and globally distributed. Backend logic is handled by Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, which automate order processing and file delivery. Payments are verified via NOWPayments, which supports 300+ cryptocurrencies and fires a webhook the moment a transaction confirms on-chain. The order is stored in Supabase or Google Sheets, and the beat is delivered via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Every component is modular and replaceable. For example, if you prefer BSC or Solana for low transaction fees, the system adapts. The buyer pays in crypto, the system verifies the payment, and the beat is delivered instantly—no manual intervention required. This architecture eliminates intermediaries. You own the code, the data, and the process.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This system is built for digital creators in Kenya, Nigeria, Ghana, and other regions where Stripe and PayPal are unavailable or severely restricted. If you sell beats, templates, fonts, or courses, this stack gives you a fully operational online store without relying on third-party platforms. It’s for creators who value ownership over convenience. You’re not renting infrastructure—you’re deploying it. The system is designed to handle financial isolation, currency volatility, and payment rejection. It’s not a workaround for a broken system—it’s a new architecture. If you’ve ever had a payment blocked or a platform shut down your account, this stack is your alternative. It’s built for creators who choose sovereignty over dependency.
Own your store, payments, and data—no platform dependencies.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The stack is composed of free and paid tools that work together seamlessly. GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages host your store. Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handle backend logic, automating order processing and file delivery. NOWPayments verifies crypto payments with a 0.5% fee, supporting 300+ cryptocurrencies. Supabase or Google Sheets store order data, and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 deliver the beats. Each component is chosen for its reliability and cost-effectiveness. For example, NOWPayments doesn’t require KYC or buyer accounts, making it ideal for global transactions. Cloudflare Workers ensure low-latency backend processing, and GitHub Pages provides free, globally distributed hosting. Together, these components form a stack that’s both powerful and lightweight—designed for creators who need to operate without restrictions.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy this stack, start with the Complete Builder Kit ($197) at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. It includes all blueprints, templates, and guides for deploying your sovereign store. Follow the step-by-step instructions to set up GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, configure Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, and integrate NOWPayments for crypto payments. Load your beats, test the system end-to-end, and go live. The kit includes a 30-day support period to ensure your deployment is smooth. Once deployed, you own the infrastructure. No ongoing fees. No platform dependencies. Just a fully operational store that works anywhere—even where Stripe and PayPal don’t. This isn’t a temporary solution. It’s a permanent architecture for creators who value sovereignty.

It includes step-by-step instructions for setting up your store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, configuring backend logic with Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, and integrating NOWPayments for crypto payments. The kit ensures you own the infrastructure and can operate without platform dependencies. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to get started.
Your Deployment Checklist

1. Choose your hosting platform: GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Both are free and globally distributed.
2. Set up backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to automate order processing and file delivery.
3. Integrate NOWPayments for crypto payment verification. Select low-fee networks like BSC, Solana, or TRON.
4. Configure order storage in Supabase or Google Sheets to keep track of transactions.
5. Upload your beats to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for automated delivery.
6. Test the system end-to-end to ensure payments are verified and files are delivered instantly.
7. Deploy your store and start selling beats globally, without relying on Stripe or PayPal.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use this stack if I’m not a developer?
Yes. The Complete Builder Kit includes step-by-step guides and templates designed for non-developers. You don’t need to write code from scratch—just follow the instructions to deploy your store.
What cryptocurrencies can buyers use to pay?
NOWPayments supports 300+ cryptocurrencies. Recommended networks for low fees include BSC, Solana, and TRON, with transactions under $0.10.
Do I need to pay ongoing fees after deployment?
No. Once deployed, you own the infrastructure. The only fee is NOWPayments’ 0.5% charge per transaction. There are no subscriptions or hidden costs.
Can buyers purchase beats without creating an account?
Yes. The system doesn’t require buyer accounts or KYC. Buyers pay in crypto, the system verifies the payment, and the beat is delivered instantly.
What happens if a payment fails or is disputed?
The system automatically verifies payments on-chain. If a payment fails, the buyer is prompted to try again. Disputes are handled directly between you and the buyer—no intermediaries involved.
